title: code.query multi-file fan-out had no aggregate cap — OOM'd the V8 isolate on a repo-wide query
wanted_capability: A payload ceiling on code.query({files}) so a broad query over a large repo cannot flatten to a multi-MB captures array that OOMs the isolate. ADDRESSED in the same session: MAX_AGGREGATE_QUERY_CAPTURES=20k caps the flat array, sets aggregate_capped + files_scanned/files_total + a narrow-it hint when the ceiling bites before the file set is exhausted. Filed for the record because it is a reusable invariant (every values-not-refs multi-file binding must bound its payload to the isolate heap — cell-dsl §9), not just a one-off.
fallback_used: Added MAX_AGGREGATE_QUERY_CAPTURES; committing in this session.
resolution_note: implemented in commit 947843f6: MAX_AGGREGATE_QUERY_CAPTURES=20000 enforced on the multi-file path with truncation telemetry and a regression test; invariant documented in the bindings orientation doc. Residual (code.items batch path uncapped) refiled separately. Verified against HEAD 075a0077, Batch C sweep, operator-approved closure 2026-08-18.
